# Psalm 126 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** A song for the journey to Jerusalem. When the LORD brought us back to Zion, it was like waking from a dream.

**2** Our mouths were full of laughter and our tongues were shouting for joy! Even the other nations said, 'The LORD has done incredible things for them!'

**3** Yes — the LORD has done incredible things for us! We are overjoyed!

**4** LORD, restore our fortunes again, like rain filling the dry riverbeds of the Negev!

**5** Those who plant seeds with tears will harvest with shouts of joy!

**6** The farmer goes out crying, carrying his bag of seed. But he comes home singing, carrying an armload of grain!

---
## PNEUMA's Meaning Notes

- **126:5-6**: One of the most beautiful promises in the Bible: if you plant seeds through your tears, you will harvest with joy. Suffering isn't wasted — it's seed. And harvest is coming.

— PNEUMA
